items.title: Securitize Will Mint Stablecoins Directly With Anchorage Digital Bank
items.summary: The tokenization platform behind funds from BlackRock, Apollo and KKR said it will source the dollars that settle those trades from a federally chartered bank instead of intermediaries.

items.title: Dogecoin Labs launches as DOGE ecosystem seeks growth beyond meme-driven demand
items.summary: Dogecoin Labs, backed by the Dogecoin Foundation, unites MyDoge, DogeOS and Such App to push DOGE into payments and DeFi.

items.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
items.summary: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

items.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
items.summary: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.
